questions.questionText: hour You must answer on the multiple choice answer sheet. You will need: Multiple choice answer sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) INSTRUCTIONS  There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions.  For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Follow the instructions on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Write in soft pencil.  Write your name, centre number and candidate number on the multiple choice answer sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you.  Do not use correction fluid.  Do not write on any bar codes.  You may use a calculator. INFORMATION  The total mark for this paper is 40.  Each correct answer will score one mark.  Any rough working should be done on this question paper.

Some features of a disease are listed. ● It can be transmitted by animals to other animals, including humans. ● One mode of transmission is by transfusion with contaminated blood. ● The causative organism can show multiple drug resistance. ● The majority of humans who die from the disease are children. Which disease has all these features?

The following advice was given to a person travelling to a country where there had been an outbreak of an infectious disease. ● Cook food well and eat it hot. ● Peel fruit and vegetables. ● Drink only cool, boiled water. ● Wash hands often with soap and cool, boiled water. Which infectious disease would this advice help to protect against?
Which description of multiple drug resistance in bacteria is correct?

options.A: Bacteria have DNA with resistant genes for several different types of antibiotic.
options.B: Different species of bacteria have DNA with resistant genes for one type of antibiotic.
options.C: Large numbers of one species of bacteria are immune to several different types of antibiotic.
options.D: Many different species of bacteria are immune to one type of antibiotic.

questions.questionText: Which description of a T-lymphocyte is correct?

options.A: They are only found in blood and secrete cytokines in response to infection.
options.B: They can leave the blood and accumulate at sites of inflammation.
options.C: They can leave the blood and secrete cytotoxins when exposed to bacteria.
options.D: They circulate in the blood and always present antigens in response to infection.
